parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian Church Slavonic *восторженый (*vostorženyj), originally past passive participle of восторгнꙋти (vostorgnuti, “to pull out”); compare отве́рженный (otvéržennyj), originally past passive participle of отве́ргнуть (otvérgnutʹ).
Borrowed from Russian Church Slavonic исполинъ (ispolinŭ), from Proto-Slavic *jьspolinъ; compare Old Church Slavonic споловъ (spolovŭ), Old Polish stolim, stolin, Kashubian stolem, stolëm, stolim.
